comparison.objective: Move an extraction-hood foot while keeping its mouth fixed, unlike setting and locking an opening stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanually stabilize one linked body while translating another against a spring.
comparison.success_condition: Foot moves about 7 cm while mouth displacement remains within its allowed region.
comparison.reason: It shares counteraction against mechanism forces, but tests linked-body repositioning rather than two-tool threaded locking and retained cycles.
